name: Coimbatore
desc: Serving families and business owners across Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, Insurance Support offers independent, IRDAI-certified consultancy. From high-sum-assured term plans to family floater health policies, we help you secure the right coverage with full claim recovery backup.
it_focus: Group health and individual term insurance for IT cluster employees at Tidel Park Coimbatore and CHIL SEZ.
senior_focus: Doorstep health insurance renewal and LIC maturity processing for established families in RS Puram and Race Course Road.
branch_dets: Direct coordination with LIC branch at Trichy Road and major insurer offices at RS Puram.

local_faqs.question: Which Coimbatore hospitals accept cashless health insurance?
local_faqs.answer: G Kuppuswamy Naidu Hospital, PSG Hospital, Kovai Medical Center, and Sri Ramakrishna Hospital are in our cashless network.

local_faqs.question: Do you provide insurance for textile factory workers in Coimbatore?
local_faqs.answer: Yes, we structure group mediclaim, Employees Compensation Act policies, and personal accident cover for textile units.
